method: Normal and reduced motion both exercised. Phone users tap the inline Contents link. Tablet users focus and activate with Enter. Desktop users click in the right rail. Separate phone/tablet runs use direct URL fragments. Heading screenshots are taken after it is in the viewport and has settled for six frames, with a minimum 450ms dwell, then after another 2000ms. Only the paired heading-detail images are cropped relative to the heading. Full viewport sheets preserve native scrolling. The real D3 and Pixi libraries were supplied from their locally archived copies. External non-graph requests were blocked. Surroundings use reduced motion apart from the separately exercised graph.
